name: Héhalom (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and green in the ratio 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Héhalom (a crowned blue and red shield with a tree, a bunch of grapes and a wavy stripe) above a yellow scroll inscribed HÉHALOM.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Héhalom arms with crown and scroll
